dialogs.about: 손주와 오후 간식을 나눠 먹으며 이야기

lines.en: Grandma, can I have some candy?
You ate candy after lunch today.
Then what can I eat now?
lines.ko: 그러면 지금은 뭘 먹을 수 있어요?

lines.en: Try these crackers. They are crunchy and healthy.
lines.ko: 이 크래커를 먹어 봐요. 바삭하고 몸에 좋아요.

lines.en: They taste good. Is there cream in them?
No, but there are nuts inside.
I love nuts. Thank you, Grandma.
I made an apple pie this morning.
Wow! When will we eat the pie?
We will eat it after dinner tonight.
lines.ko: 오늘 저녁 먹고 나서 먹을 거예요.

lines.en: Hello! What will you choose today?
I am not sure. The pudding looks good.
I ate the chocolate pie here last week.
lines.ko: 저는 지난주에 여기서 초콜릿 파이를 먹었어요.

lines.en: Was it too sweet for you?
No, it is not too sweet. Please try it.
lines.ko: 아니요, 그렇게 달지 않아요. 한번 드셔 봐요.

lines.en: Then I will take one chocolate pie.
The cream on the pie melts very fast.
lines.ko: 파이 위의 크림은 아주 빨리 녹아요.

lines.en: Do they have crunchy chips too?
Yes, but the crackers are better here.
lines.ko: 네, 그런데 여기는 크래커가 더 좋아요.

lines.en: Thank you for your help today.
